title: Finite locally constant subsystems of a torsion local system
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth, def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme], and let $G$ be an abelian sheaf [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Assume its underlying set sheaf is a local system [def-per-ind-finite-etale-local-system] and every element of each geometric stalk [def-weil-geometric-point, def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] is killed by some positive integer. Then the finite locally constant subgroup sheaves of $G$, ordered by inclusion, form a small filtered poset whose union is $G$. Finite locally constant means etale locally isomorphic to the constant sheaf of a finite abelian group [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Both the colimit of their underlying set sheaves and their colimit as abelian sheaves identify with $G$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].

source.place: Expose XVII, Lemma 7.2.6, p. 303: the torsion local system is written as the filtered union of its finite local subsystems.
